owner_scope: 2026-09-22: After PR #10 shipped, the owner rejected its aesthetic quality and the unchanged remainder of the app, clarifying that the task is to redesign the complete site/app with its concept and purpose in mind. The entire player, coach and parent/mentor experience is in scope, not only the finished-training journey. Confirmed audience: players aged 10-14 with parent support. Confirmed lead character: Football academy, with bold sports typography, strong player identity, tactical graphics and purposeful layouts, energetic rather than childish. Golazo's cobalt/coral palette and neutral surfaces remain selected. These choices establish intent, not approval of the current multipage concepts or of every proposed page. The present stage is held concept comparison and inventory; no production implementation, approval receipt, PR or deployment is authorized by it.
inventory_basis: Scanned the complete src/main.tsx -> App.tsx static/lazy dependency graph at production base 1a0b81b80ca7c0bdf73b1074a8c5bc7fdbb8dcfc: all 73 TSX files, 65 imported and 8 explicitly unimported, recorded in docs/design-directions/academy-20260922/source-map.json. Inspected App Page render branches, BottomNav player/coach/mentor menus, navigation callbacks, component state and nested forms/details/dialogs, including LogPage, LearnPage/Exercises, Profile, SchedulePage, TeamPicker/AddTeamDialog, TournamentImport/FootballPortal, onboarding, coach roster/planner/evaluation/attendance/announcements/challenges and MentorDashboard. This role-paired source inventory expands the 60 design-treatment groups in COVERAGE.md; those groups are not a substitute for this manifest. Entries identify existing owning components and mark proposed consolidation or currently unwired entry points explicitly. Settings are currently inline in Profile; their separate concept page is not an approved new capability. Leaderboard has a render branch but no inbound player link was found; its existing friends/challenge capability remains in whole-product scope with that gap recorded. Declared Page values coach/squads have no matching render branch and are not invented as additional production pages: the actual coach home is dashboard with coach role. TournamentPage.tsx, WeeklySummary.tsx and six ui helpers are unimported and are not counted as live entry points. Shared components are enumerated separately for each reachable role and materially distinct entry context; loading/error/empty/hover states remain obligations of their owning surfaces rather than acceptance claims. Visitor means unauthenticated; unassigned means an authenticated new user before role choice. Native OS file/share pickers retain platform behavior and are covered by their owning app flows. No entry in this file asserts implementation completion or owner approval; the source gate cannot discover omissions.
